persona_assignment_rationale: The persona is a 22-year-old white female living in urban New York, working in retail, highly progressive, and a regular news consumer. Variables chosen reflect race (white), sex (female), urban residence (large city over 250,000 population), political views (liberal as a proxy for highly progressive), frequency of political news consumption (several times a day for regular news consumer), employment status (working full time), and occupation sector (retail trade). Age is not directly represented in variables, so omitted.
